description: next/ v2.0 — ISA-95 EquipmentClass: a class/type grouping of equipment (capability/role). The binding axis a ProductDefinition reaches via OperationsSegment SPECIFIES_EQUIPMENT (a spec valid for a class of equipment/line rather than one unit).

properties.name: name
properties.description: Display name of the equipment class.

properties.name: base_equipment_class_ref
properties.description: The EquipmentClass (INCLUDES_PROPERTIES_OF; ISA-95 EquipmentClass → EquipmentClass). Optional.

properties.name: parent_equipment_class_ref
properties.description: The EquipmentClass this EquipmentClass is part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 EquipmentClass MADE_UP_OF EquipmentClass). Optional.

properties.name: test_specification_ref
properties.description: The TestSpecification (TESTED_BY; ISA-95 EquipmentClass → TestSpecification). Optional.

isa95.note: ISA-95 EquipmentClass — SPECIFIES_EQUIPMENT target via OperationsSegment for ProductDefinition; classifies Units.
isa95.mappingNote: name: B2MML EquipmentClass has ID and Description only; the short display name has no element of its own (description maps to Description). Self-nesting and containment are PART_OF on the child with a reference to the parent (B2MML nests the child inside the parent).
